site.title: Indian Constitution Portal
site.tagline: Discover the foundation of India's democracy: articles, amendments, and laws.
site.description: An educational resource on the Indian Constitution, created to promote awareness of democratic principles.

fundamentalRights.title: Right to Equality
fundamentalRights.description: Ensures equality before the law and prohibits discrimination.

fundamentalRights.title: Right to Freedom
fundamentalRights.description: Freedom of speech, assembly, movement, and personal liberty.

fundamentalRights.title: Right Against Exploitation
fundamentalRights.description: Prohibits trafficking, forced labor, and child labor.

fundamentalRights.title: Right to Freedom of Religion
fundamentalRights.description: Freedom of conscience and the right to practice any religion.

schedules.title: 7th Schedule
schedules.description: Division of powers between Union and States.

amendments.title: 1st Amendment (1951)
amendments.description: Abolished zamindari, added land reforms, and restricted freedom of speech for public order.

amendments.title: 7th Amendment (1956)
amendments.description: Reorganized states on linguistic basis, creating new states like Andhra Pradesh.

amendments.title: 24th Amendment (1971)
amendments.description: Abolished privy purses for former rulers and nationalized banks.

amendments.title: 42nd Amendment (1976)
amendments.description: Added Fundamental Duties, changed preamble to "secular democratic republic," and strengthened central powers.

amendments.title: 44th Amendment (1978)
amendments.description: Restored fundamental rights, limited emergency powers, and protected property rights.

amendments.title: 73rd Amendment (1992)
amendments.description: Granted constitutional status to Panchayats for local self-governance.

amendments.title: 86th Amendment (2002)
amendments.description: Made education a fundamental right for children aged 6-14.
